description: The plot illustrates how BLEU score varies as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four methods (Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi). The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning slightly below 0 to about 10, with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.0, 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging from about 18 to just under 29, with major tick labels at 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, and 28. The Consistency-CE series is drawn as a light purple dashed line with circular markers, increasing from about 18.8 at AL ≈ 0 to about 27.0 at AL ≈ 10, passing through roughly 22.9 at AL ≈ 3 and 26.4 at AL ≈ 7.5. The Inconsistency-CE series is drawn as a darker purple solid line with square markers, rising from about 20.1 at AL ≈ 0 to about 27.0 at AL ≈ 10, with intermediate points near 23.0 at AL ≈ 3, 24.5 at AL ≈ 4.5, and 26.4 at AL ≈ 7.5. The Inconsistency-CE-MP series is drawn as a blue dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 18.5 at AL just below 0 (leftmost point) to about 27.1 at AL ≈ 10, with points around 21.8 at AL ≈ 1.5, 24.6 at AL ≈ 4.5, and about 26.3–26.4 between AL ≈ 7 and 8. The Consistency-Bi series is drawn as a red solid line with star markers, increasing from about 22.4 at AL ≈ 1 to about 28.5 at AL ≈ 10, with visible points near 26.1 at AL ≈ 3, 27.3 at AL ≈ 6, and a high point around 28.7 at AL ≈ 8.5 before a slight decrease at the final point.
